cards.text: During Advance, ignore Ballistic recoil if movement costs no more than half your speed, rounded up. Apply heat to speed first and count terrain costs.
cards.reminder: Pay action and Energy heat normally.

cards.text: Take no damage when you Disengage. Follow the normal movement and contact rules.
cards.reminder: Move up to half speed. No attack. Gain 1 heat.

cards.text: Add 1 close damage against a vehicle or 'Mech when attacking its rear or while it is shutdown. Equipment and pilot damage bonuses together cannot exceed +1.
cards.reminder: No bonus to the attack roll.

cards.text: Vent cools 1 extra click, even while shutdown. Stop at the heat dial's starting position.
